release_change_decision: NO GAME PATCH / NO VERSION BUMP; V614 remains the latest public game

open_findings.title: Actual 3+ in-game minutes on Galaxy S23+ remain unmeasured
open_findings.facts: 240 wall seconds in GitHub headless Chrome advanced 138.0 in-game seconds; 29 auto choices even at 180ms poll. Do not assert user's phone lag resolved.
open_findings.next: Collect handset 3-5 minute gameplay with FPS/heat/return-from-background and log/personal video if user voluntarily supplies.

open_findings.title: Browser callback frame interval p95 rose to 50ms in 240s wall sample
open_findings.facts: 60/180s independent headless runs gave p95 ~33.3ms, 240s run gave p95 50ms, p99 66.7ms and 24 intervals >100ms; 90 live monsters at end. Different tests and loading make causality uncertain.
open_findings.next: Reproduce on same browser/device/configuration; profile jank by CPU/GPU function and pause overlays, not randomly lower graphics.

open_findings.title: 250 actual living monster objects pass 30-step short fixed-dt exercise
open_findings.facts: 50/180/250 alive exactly, draw-call p95 24.6/27.5/30.2ms; fixed 0.48 simulated seconds and original Chrome render functions, NOT continuous FPS or 5-minute wave.
open_findings.next: Add 180/250 genuine wave 3min clock benchmark later; only optimize hot spots if repeatable.

open_findings.title: Manual gun/blade/spike/whip and BIO/VENOM close/far game-feel ratings absent
open_findings.facts: 8 monster core hit types, 4 midboss skills, native BIO/VENOM spawns and existing functional regressions pass; no human reviewer gave punch/clarity/rhythm scores.
open_findings.next: Ask user to play representative 1-minute battle; don't fabricate 1-5 ratings.

open_findings.title: Remaining five planned TITANs not established as playable
open_findings.facts: BIO, VENOM native QA fixtures available; other five cannot be claimed as completed.
open_findings.next: Treat unsupported titan fixtures as unavailable, not game failures.

open_findings.title: No evidence for additional rendered sprites
open_findings.facts: 1021 legacy images preserved; no new image requirement in STEP08.
open_findings.next: Keep image production separate until observed design requirement.

confirmed_no_regression: V614 manifest and original full engine bytes unchanged
8 real monster species receive real 25 HP damage and hit signal
one death echo, four midboss attack warning profiles, five tiers and BIO/VENOM native spawns work
GitHub browser 60/180/240 real-wall samples recorded, not treated as phone performance
50/180/250 unique real monster draws succeed in fixed-time QA, original game CPU path
not_tested: all seven planned Titans actual player fights

release_criteria.reason_no_patch: Known gaps and headless-frame warnings do not isolate a production code defect; changing balance, animations or graphics would introduce unjustified regressions.

backups: Previous STEP08 10–80% Git recovery branches preserved; STEP08 90% recovery branch to follow merge.
